<MethodEndpoint

  context={'endpoint'}

Records that the end customer accepted one published version the onboarding already holds, typically the `latestAgreementId` of a family `GET /v1/onboardings/{id}/agreements` reports as `outdated` or `not_accepted`. Idempotent: a repeat reports the original `acceptedAt`, and `200` says nothing is created beyond the recorded acceptance. Not gated on the lifecycle status, so an approved customer can still accept new terms. Only a version the onboarding is already linked to can be accepted, which is what keeps this open route from being a way to attach arbitrary versions to an onboarding.
